gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-bamum: Bowl-heavy letters bent from thin steel rod, full of swagger. Noto Sans Bamum handles the quiet work, with open-mouthed small letters, while Righteous is best at grabbing attention outright.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-bassa-vah: Letters like bent tubing, bowls filling every line. Noto Sans Bassa Vah keeps quietly to its job, a tall midsection and open-jawed c, while Righteous is the one built to command attention.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-batak: Righteous bends thin steel rod into fat-bowled, fun letters. Noto Sans Batak towers in x-height yet never squeezes its e shut, so whole paragraphs keep flowing at a friendly pace.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-bengali: Noto Sans Bengali keeps capitals barely taller than lowercase, with distinctly open letter mouths that make text feel unhurried. And across a page it moves smoothly, while Righteous overhead keeps its bent-rod swagger.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-bhaiksuki: Letters bent from a single length of wire, bowls filling the line. Righteous is best at commanding attention, but Noto Sans Bhaiksuki is built for steady reading, its swollen lowercase and open apertures clear to follow.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-buginese: Steady marker-like lines, fat bowls, and plenty of attitude. Noto Sans Buginese has chalk-arc open mouths and short ascenders, so text glides along gently, modern rather than loud.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-buhid: Noto Sans Buhid reads with generous space between curve ends and stems, its x-height set high. Shrink Righteous too far and its thin-rod bowls lose their punch.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-carian: Commanding from the first letter, Righteous draws flat fineliner lines with bowls that fill the line. Noto Sans Carian keeps its terminals apart like open scissor blades, so reading flows smoothly.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-chakma: Fun and commanding up top, Righteous draws its letters as if with a marker tip. And Noto Sans Chakma is where the pair is strongest: lowercase packed up toward the caps, with open, uncrowded mouths.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-cham: Pipe-cleaner letters, fat bowls, loads of swagger. Noto Sans Cham, with generous c openings and tall rounded lowercase, can be sized up a notch without losing its clean, modern ease.
